nom: Humphreys Witch Hazel Nourishing Toner with Aloe

segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin and an oily T-zone reports this is the first toner that hasn't irritated her skin, removing oil while still hydrating and helping her acne start clearing up.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no burning or breakouts, though one reviewer's skin reacted with small bumps a couple of hours after use, and another notes the alcohol content could be drying for sensitive skin even though it wasn't for her.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 50s with mature skin reports it diminished her redness and improved her skin tone.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report it cleans without drying their skin, including one who says it hydrates alongside removing oil, though one reviewer notes the alcohol content could be drying for sensitive skin, even though it wasn't for her.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report it soothes skin irritation and reduces redness, including one mature-skin reviewer who says it diminished her redness and improved her skin tone.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer, breakout-free skin, including one whose acne started clearing up, but one reviewer says it left small bumps on her face a couple of hours after each use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with an oily T-zone reports it removes excess oil while still hydrating her skin.

aspects.libelle: Controlled-dispensing seal and pull-tab design praised
Bamboo cap seen as a nice packaging touch
Strong witch hazel smell, though it fades quickly
Some bulk bottles lack a proper dispensing nozzle, causing over-pouring

extraits.texte: I’ve used it a couple times and I don’t like it , I think my skin is allergic to it, every time I use it leaves little tiny buttons on my face after a couple of hours.
I have pretty sensitive skin and I’ve used it a couple times and so far it’s been nice haven’t had any break outs and it hasn’t made my skin burn like most products so I think that’s a win!

Firstly, you should know, this stuff does not smell good. That being said, you get used to it pretty quickly. But, it is so soothing for the skin. Whenever I have skin irritation, I can use this to soothe it and reduce a little of the redness. Its also very natural. It does contain alcohol which can be drying if you have sensitive skin, but mine is not sensitive to alcohol, so it works for me. Highly recommend.

I purchased the Humphreys Witch Hazel Organic Toner Soothe & Clarify with Rose after trying out a sample that the company sent to me. I loved it! I have combination skin, but oily T-zone. This toner has been the first one that has not irritated my skin! I'm unable to use a lot of toners because they either cause irritation or dries out my skin. This toner not only gets rid of the nasty oil, but also hydrates my skin. It just feels so clean and refreshed. My acne has started clearing up as well. I really love the design of the bottle and it has an option to use the smaller hole in the seal for more controlled dispensing. I wish all products had that! I give this product a big thumbs up and will purchase again!

extraits.titre: It’s very good - and natural so kind to mature skin
extraits.texte: Really good - this is my second bottle. I’m a mature woman in her 50+ years and has helped diminished my redness and skin tone. The bottle took a while to arrive though but worth waiting for! Recommend.

extraits.titre: The best toner I’ve come across!
extraits.texte: I swear by this stuff. Can never let myself run out. It’s helped with keeping my complexion smooth and breakout free.

Have used this brand before and know how good it is. I chose this partly due to the aloe and it's alcohol free too. Feels nice and soothing when applied, no irritation at all. The downside to this toner however, is the nasty smell. I just have to hold my breath while using it. The scent goes away quickly, thank goodness!
